spatialBenefitAssessment: Potentially worthwhile: alternate credential routes and a resource-wide boundary form a real connectivity relationship missing from the recommended video, which focuses on separate execution authority. Current interaction mostly replays a fixed walk with a binary lock, and the roof hides a planar route. Revise toward direct investigation of which entrances remain reachable; acceptance requires evidence of that benefit, not just a successful animation.

findings.issue: The locked run does not demonstrate the caption that production rejects identity on every route. The corridor is always stopped by the guard check and the runtime only changes the rear-route stop.
findings.requestedChange: Replace Follow the log line with an Inspect route control cycling direct and shell paths, and use the second control to cycle guard-only, one entrance protected, and all entrances protected. Show each selected route reaching its actual enforcement point and derive reachability from the selected doors. Leave routes visible without a roof reveal.
findings.evidence: interaction.js BARRIER_STOP=2 and PASSAGE_STOP=6; locked chooses one fixed end. Both production doors appear together via Locks.visible. The Astra video covers an execution denial but does not explore alternate-path coverage.

findings.issue: Universal locked doors can read as disabling production entirely rather than denying a scoped identity; shared shell authority is only a label.
findings.requestedChange: Attach a consistent credential token to the agent and visibly match it against the production checks. State in the sole caption that this identity is denied and authorized deployment remains possible. Do not imply a physical doorway or prompt guard is the security boundary.
findings.evidence: Guide distinguishes authenticated identity/action/resource and separate deployment identity. intent explicitly omits identities; initial capture shows an unqualified lever and corridor gate.

findings.issue: Changing the boundary silently restores r41, which can imply that adding authorization rolls back an already executed deployment.
findings.requestedChange: Make the comparison reset explicit in the caption, such as New trial: r41 restored; agent identity unchanged, or preserve release state and show no further write. Apply the same treatment to replay.
findings.evidence: lockButton calls clearRun(), which sets leverTarget=0 after an unlocked run; lockedIdle only announces identity checks.

findings.issue: The bypass inspection is pointer-only, labels are small, and the claimed rear-door stop has not been captured.
findings.requestedChange: Use an open cutaway and persistent route endpoints; remove or shorten the long roof so it cannot intercept the key route view. Enlarge the release indicator and align the denied endpoint with the door instead of relying on the caption. Keep two controls plus Reset.
findings.evidence: Initial browser image makes the log instruction and r41/r42 small. onPick alone lifts the roof before a run; PASSAGE_STOP points to Route_06 at Blender (3,3.2), while the rear door occupies y=2.44..2.64. Only initial.png was available for this concept.

Verify roof/door occlusion and nearest-visible picking, keyboard-only operation, reduced motion, Reset and repeat trials at desktop and 420px.
